eras.label: current
eras.note: The Legislature adopted its own map over three alternatives proposed by the Utah Independent Redistricting Commission. Valid 2022–2032. Unrelated to the 2024–2025 congressional map litigation (League of Women Voters of Utah v. Utah State Legislature), which was congressional-only and didn't reopen House/Senate lines.
